QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Chao's Tusk
QuestInfo.0: As a proof of defeating Chao, you brought Chao's Tusk to Kanderune. Looks like he has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: Time to show everyone at camp that they need not worry about Chao. Take Chao's Tusk to #b#eLoha#n#k, and bring the goof news to the people at the camp.
QuestInfo.2: You brought Chao's Tusk to Loha, proving your story. People can now pass through the Boulder Mountains safely.

0.0: We have to tell the whole camp that Chao has been defeated! Kao, go give them the good news!

yes.0: Oh, you'll probably need the proof that you defeated Chao. Take #t4000674# to Loha.

no.0: Are you getting shy? You did an amazing thing! Tell the world!

1.0: What did Kanderune say? Did he learn anything about that giant monster?

yes.0: What?! You defeated that monster? You?! Kao...you are AMAZING! I feel like you just grew up before my eyes. Great job, Kao...really great job.
yes.1: Oh yeah, Yuris was looking for you. You should go see her.

npc.0: Take #t4000674# to Loha and tell her she can relax a little, now that Chao has been defeated. You did a great job, Kao.

item.0: Did you learn anything about that giant monster at the Boulder Mountain Cave? Or did you forget all about it? Geez, Kao...Go ask Kanderune again.

lost.0: Slow down, Kao. You dropped the tusk, didn't you? I know you're excited, but you need to be more careful. Now, take this to Loha.
